desc.en: The National Museum of the Comoros is a national museum in the capital city of Moroni on the island of Grande Comore in the Comoros, presenting the country's cultural heritage.
desc.es: El Museo Nacional de Comoras, abreviado MNC está ubicado en Moroni, capital de las Islas Comoras.
